verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS code-review tool with a CLI, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented way to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The privacy page covers adjacent controls only: a contractual no-training commitment from model providers and an option to block AI features for a workspace. Neither is a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
